slides.texte_overlay:
How to keep things interesting
when you talk to her
Play a little game. "Would you rather" questions or two truths and a lie. Simple games make conversations fun and reveal surprising stories.
Talk about a recent adventure. A trip, a new sport, a funny night out. Stories with action keep conversations lively. Keep a few ready.
Ask about her opinions, not just facts. "What do you think about..." People love sharing their views, and it leads to real discussions.
Share a passion. Something you love, explained with energy. Enthusiasm is contagious and makes you more interesting to listen to.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. A strange fact can spark a whole conversation. Keep a few ready.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. A strange fact can spark a whole conversation.

slides.texte_overlay: Laugh together about small things. A strange sign, a funny waiter, a silly memory. Shared laughter keeps the energy light.
Know when to end on a high. Leave while the conversation is still fun. She'll look forward to talking to you again. Leave them wanting more.
